<style>
/* Cicatrize 3X | Grade curricular com 17 módulos. Vai num widget HTML dentro da própria seção.
   Escopo: .cz-grade */

body .cz-assets.elementor-widget {
  position: absolute;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* o cartão do bloco segue escuro em todas as telas (a regra antiga deixava petróleo só no celular) */
.cz-grade .cz-block2.e-con {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
}

/* mockup pequeno sobre o quadro claro */
.cz-grade .cz-block-media.e-con {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cz-grade .cz-block-img img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .cz-grade .cz-block2:hover .cz-block-img img {
    transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-1deg);
  }
}

/* título do módulo: "Módulo 01 · 20 h" em cima, nome embaixo */
.cz-grade .cz-grade-acc .cz-dn {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: #CF8A86;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.cz-grade .cz-grade-acc .e-n-accordion {
  gap: 8px;
}

/* tópicos */
.cz-grade .cz-mbody p {
  margin: 0;
}

.cz-grade .cz-msub {
  margin: 4px 0 8px !important;
  color: #0F4F5C;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.cz-grade .cz-topics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 6px 18px;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.cz-grade .cz-topics li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 16px;
}

.cz-grade .cz-topics li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.55em;
  left: 0;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #CF8A86;
}

.cz-grade .cz-mprof {
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(15, 79, 92, 0.18);
  color: #0F4F5C;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.cz-grade .cz-mprof span {
  color: #3B5C66;
  font-weight: 400;
}

/* tablet e celular: mockup como miniatura ao lado do nome do bloco */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .cz-grade .cz-block-side.e-con > .cz-block-media {
    flex: 0 0 34%;
    max-width: 34%;
    width: 34%;
  }

  .cz-grade .cz-block-side.e-con > .cz-block-info {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    width: auto;
  }

  .cz-grade .cz-block-img img {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .cz-grade .cz-topics {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .cz-grade .cz-grade-acc .cz-dn {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
}

/* computador: mockup + nome do bloco acompanham a rolagem da lista */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .cz-grade .cz-block-side.e-con {
    position: sticky;
    top: 40px;
    align-self: flex-start;
  }
}
</style>
